data.one_liner: A script manager to define and run shortcut scripts inside your pubspec.yaml file.
data.what_it_does: Derry allows Dart and Flutter developers to define shortcut scripts inside pubspec.yaml or a separate yaml file. It saves developers from typing long commands by offering clean shorthand execution, pre and post scripts, and nested script references.
use_when: You want to manage and shorten long build or test command lines in your Dart/Flutter projects
You need pre and post hook executions around your build or publish steps
avoid_when: You are looking for a state management or UI widget library
strengths: Reduces repetitive typing of long command lines
Supports nested scripts, pre/post scripts, and script references
weaknesses: Relies on FFI and platform-specific shells (cmd on Windows, bash on Linux/Mac)
data.setup_notes: Install derry as a global dependency via dart pub global activate derry, and define scripts in your pubspec.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
scripts:
  build: dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
